title: NAWA Real Estate
tagline: Next.js listing site for NAWA's real-estate inventory, distinct from the holding-company brochure.
overview: NAWA Real Estate is the property-listing sibling of the NAWA Holding site: filters, property cards, and a catalog structure instead of a corporate story.
problem: The holding-company site could not carry a searchable inventory without turning into a cluttered brochure.
solution: A dedicated Next.js app for listings so the holding site stays institutional and this one stays operational.
architecture: Next.js App Router front-end with structured listing data and card/filter UI. Kept in its own repo from nawa-holding and nawa_production.
features: Brand-aligned layout shared conceptually with the holding site
challenges: Deciding what belongs on the holding site versus the inventory app
lessonsLearned: Two focused sites beat one page that tries to sell the company and every unit at once
futureImprovements: CMS-backed listing ingest so agents can update inventory without a deploy
results: A dedicated listings surface next to the live NAWA production site
